name: plan-steps
description: A side pane that shows Claude's current plan step by step, a little animated Claude, and your Apple (iCloud) calendar

calendarUser.title: Apple ID
calendarUser.description: The email of your Apple ID (or your CalDAV username). Leave empty to hide the calendar.

calendarPassword.title: App-specific password
calendarPassword.description: Made at account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords. Not your Apple ID password.

showCalendar.title: Show calendar
showCalendar.description: Show the calendar section in the Plan pane.

days.title: Days to show
days.description: How many days from today (1 to 14).

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: columns: days side by side; list: one day under another.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the calendar sits in the pane.

hiddenCalendars.title: Hidden calendars
hiddenCalendars.description: Calendar names to leave out, separated by commas (e.g. Birthdays, Work).

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA name such as Europe/Paris. Empty uses the computer's time zone.

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the calendar is fetched again.

serverUrl.title: CalDAV server
serverUrl.description: https://caldav.icloud.com for Apple; any CalDAV server with a username and password also works (Fastmail, Nextcloud...).
